roads.name: Lake Miramar Access Road
words: Curve after curve after curve: 35 in 3.5 miles, about 10 a mile.
Tight and technical: most curves turn on a radius under 130 ft.
From 706 to 762 ft, with 594 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 15 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.16 g.

roads.name: Via de la Valle
words: Properly twisty: 18 curves in 3.3 miles, about 5 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 25 to 252 ft, with 334 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 45 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.37 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Monument Road
words: Properly twisty: 18 curves in 2.7 miles, about 7 a mile.
From 17 to 80 ft, with 273 ft of up and down along the way.
Homes line much of it: about 56 buildings a mile beside the road.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.87 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this takes California's 55 mph.
